packages.title: Stremio Origin
packages.shortDescription: Native app for Stremio addons on LG webOS TVs. Unofficial.

manifest.title: Stremio Origin
manifest.appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV, in English or Arabic: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Now on Google TV: Stremio Origin for Google TV and Android TV, on TVs and boxes from 2020 on: the same app, your accounts and settings, updates from inside the app.
Made for its remote: The D-pad, OK and Back do everything. Captions, Audio and Info keys go straight to their lists; Menu opens Settings, Search opens Search.
Sound and picture as made: On Google TV, Dolby Atmos, DTS and TrueHD go to your receiver as they are, and the screen follows the film's frame rate.
